title: RM6785 channel post
description: One ROM, recovery or kernel build, as announced in @RM6785.

postType.description: Which kind of build this is. Decides the post's shape.

name.description: the complete displayed name, including version, e.g. Infinity-X 3.12

tag.description: the one-word hashtag and folder name without #, e.g. InfinityX or PBRP

stability.description: The bracketed word at the end of the title.

releaseType.description: Third hashtag. Not used by kernel posts.

device.description: RM6785 for every supported device; nemo (Realme 6 family) or salaa (Realme 7 family) for one. RMX2001 and RMX2151 are the retired names of nemo and salaa.

androidVersion.description: ROM posts only — 10 to 17, optionally with detail, e.g. 16 or 16 QPR1

kernelVersion.description: kernel posts only, a single line, e.g. 4.14.336

ruiVersion.description: RealmeUI major version. Becomes the #RUI3 hashtag.

author.description: a single line, e.g. Hakimi & Ansh; a linked name may use [ELOHIM](https://example.com)

buildDate.description: an ISO date, e.g. 2026-08-17 — shown in the post as 17-08-2026

banner.description: Direct link to the image or GIF shown above the post.

bugs.description: Known bugs. Say "None known" rather than leaving it out.

buildType.description: ROM posts only. Which flavour this build is, e.g. Vanilla or GApps.

fileSize.description: one or more sizes, e.g. 1.5 GB or 2.0GB | 1.6GB

screenshots.description: Required for ROM and recovery posts, unused by kernel posts.

items.description: one line per bullet; inline links may use [text](https://example.com)

bullets.description: One line per bullet. Blank lines are not allowed.
